author: Cory M.
reviewBody: Came out after hours and fixed a leak at my watermain. Daniel is great.

author: Patty C.
reviewBody: Was very pleased with Tyler Manley. He was professional, nice and knew what needed to be done. Answered my questions and cleaned up. Even my dog liked him. Had used Woods plumbing years ago and will keep them on my contact list

author: Robbie P.
reviewBody: Fantastic service Fabian was wonderful very professional and knew what he was doing it wasn't an easy job! I called at 7Am Fabian was here by 10AM. If you ever need a plumber call these guys.

author: Margaret G.
reviewBody: Jacob was very courteous and communicated well. He was great at explaining everything about what was going on in detail. He was very knowledgeable and answered all of our questions. I would highly recommend Jacob from Wood's Plumbing to family and friends.

author: Patricia F.
reviewBody: We have a broken water main. No water coming into our property at all. I called your company and they responded quickly and got someone else same day. Marty was very polite and respectful and got the job done. Thank you.

author: Rose W.
reviewBody: Very courteous and professional. Fabian was great. He handled a problem we had when he opened the brand new toilet and found it was broken. Right away I contacted the seller and they were happy to send someone to my home with a replacement and take the broken one. Once it arrived Fabian got right to work. He completed the job and left his work area spotless.

author: Tim S.
reviewBody: I had a rather significant under slab leak that happened over the weekend... He pinpointed the site of the leak using an electronic wand device, and explained what he will do. He gave me a reasonable quote and returned and fixed it. And yes the site of the leak was where he diagnosed it.

author: Jim F.
reviewBody: I am experienced in home repair and plumbing and know good work when I see it and on this job I saw it. Wood's did a whole house repipe for us. Bart and his crew were exceptional. The quality of the work far exceeded industry standards and was done with exceptional skill.

author: Geri F.
reviewBody: Had four different plumbing companies quote an installation for a new hot water tank, recirc pump and pressure regulator... I chose them because of the honesty in the plumber's explanation of the entire process... The work was outstanding, very neat and tidy, quality workmanship and attention to detail.

author: Lisa L.
reviewBody: Extremely professional and knowledgeable. It was clear they knew what they were doing and they were so personable. I will recommend them to anyone who needs a total repipe as well.
